pages.text: "Wow! An empty cart!" Big sister Dodo strode across the yard on long legs. Dad had unloaded all the wheat sacks. "I'll give you rides. One at a time, once around the yard!"
"I know! Big sister first!" Dodo hopped aboard. Little brother Mumu watched from the middle of the spring yard. "I want a ride too..." Rattle, rattle. Dad pulled the cart around once.
After one round, the cart stopped, but Dodo didn't get off. "Again! Big sister first means me again!" Mumu fiddled with his blue scarf, beak pouting.
Dad let go of the handles and sat beside Dodo. "How would you feel if Mumu never got off?" She tilted her head and shut her beak. "Hmm... I'd have to keep watching the cart..."
Dad smiled. "Then take turns. One round, get off, then Mumu. You ride, Mumu rides, both get a ride." Dodo's eyes sparkled. "Cart rides, take turns!"
"One, one round, then get off!" At Dad's words, Dodo hopped down. One round wheel track lay in the yard dirt. Now Mumu's turn.
"Two, wait for my turn!" Dad called. This time Mumu rode. Dodo stayed behind, wings together behind her back, shifting one foot, then the other. She murmured, "Cart rides, take turns!"
"Three, round finished, next turn!" Dad called. At last, Dodo's turn! As the cart rattled, she flicked her tail once. Two round wheel tracks lay side by side in the dirt.

In the yard, Dad lowered his back flat. Mumu climbed on first. "One, one round, then get off! Two, wait for my turn! Three, round finished, next turn!" Stepping half a pace back, Dodo called, "Mumu first, take turns!"
Dad hugged both in his wings. "Taking turns is much more fun, right?" Wait a little, and both you and I enjoy it. Dodo called, and Mumu followed. "Cart rides, take turns!" "Take turns!"
